home.title: Turning business rules into practical software.
home.description: I’m Vinícius Gabriel, a back-end developer with experience in financial and accounting systems. I work on APIs, integrations and investment fund business rules, and explore personal products from interface to deployment.
home.focus: Java back-end, with a view of the whole product.

about.title: How I work
about.intro: I focus on software that makes sense for its users and the business it serves.
paragraphs: I work with Java and Spring Boot on financial systems. My experience includes investment fund assets and liabilities, REST APIs, integrations and post-deployment support.

Previously, I developed accounting applications and worked in technical support and infrastructure. Direct contact with users shaped my approach: understand the problem and business rules before choosing a solution.

My personal projects explore domain modeling, authentication, testing, web interfaces, mobile apps and container operations. I use AI as a development tool while continuing to improve my analysis, solution review and behavioral validation.

projects.title: Selected projects
projects.intro: Personal products for finance and learning, combining web applications, integrations and delivery infrastructure.
projects.ai: Developed with extensive AI assistance. These descriptions reflect implemented scope; each product continues to evolve.

anti.title: Anti-Arrombo
anti.description: Financial organization with reviewable statement imports, recurring transactions, cards and receipt OCR. Web interface and MCP tools for integration with AI clients.
anti.detail: Transactional idempotency, ports and adapters, architecture tests and a separate OCR service.

astra.title: Astra
astra.description: Study maps shaped like constellations. Prerequisites, study sessions and next-topic suggestions help visualize a learning path.
astra.detail: Graph validation, YAML import, hierarchical progress and WebGL visualization.

engrama.title: Engrama
engrama.description: A knowledge portfolio with practice, learning evidence and spaced repetition. Combines a web interface, Android app and MCP integration.
engrama.detail: FSRS adapter and offline answer synchronization with acknowledgement and account isolation.

infra.title: Subarashii Infra
infra.description: Hosting and operations configuration for these products: HTTPS routing, identity, databases, observability and backup routines.
infra.detail: Containers, Traefik, Keycloak, SOPS-encrypted secrets and versioned delivery configuration.

projects.archiveIntro: Experiments, academic work and earlier portfolio versions that are part of my development journey.

linear-system.title: Linear Systems Calculator
linear-system.description: A calculator that solves linear systems with n variables using the Gauss method. The user can input the equations and the program returns the solution of the system.

bot-notification.title: Discord Bot Notification
bot-notification.description: A bot that performs web scraping on a light novels website and posts announcements on Discord according to the new publications.

uno-java.title: UNO Game in Java with Terminal Interface
uno-java.description: A Java implementation of UNO with a terminal interface, exploring object-oriented programming and game rules.

portifolio-v2.title: Portfolio v2
portifolio-v2.description: This portfolio: a bilingual website built with Next.js, React and TypeScript, with light and dark themes.

portifolio-v1.title: Portfolio v1
portifolio-v1.description: My first portfolio. The project was made with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React.

corona-vapo.title: Corona Vapo
corona-vapo.description: A game developed in Godot, aimed at raising awareness about COVID-19 distancing. The player faces various infected people who are zombies and receives various messages regarding the recommended measures.

medplus.title: MedPlus
medplus.description: A project that simulates a system for managing a clinic. The user can create, edit, and delete appointments, as well as view the appointments already scheduled.

party-manager.title: Birthday Party Manager
party-manager.description: A project for managing birthday parties. The user can create, edit, and delete parties, as well as view the parties already created.
